ui.go_to_case_hint: Paste the case ID or the full address of the case. You cannot search by applicant name.

ui.copy_manual: Could not copy automatically. The text is selected: copy it with Ctrl+C.

ui.resolve_conflict: Nothing was recorded: the model version is no longer frozen or its current state does not allow this action (for example, it was already reactivated). Close this dialog and check “Latest recorded resolution” and the history; there is no need to repeat the action.
ui.resolve_mfa_hint: This action requires a two-step verification from the last {minutes} minutes and yours is not that recent. When you press “Verify and confirm”, a window opens to verify your identity; when you finish, the resolution is sent automatically with what you wrote.
ui.session_mfa_help: Sensitive actions (such as resolving a freeze) require having verified your identity with a second factor within the last {minutes} minutes. If you have not, a window opens on confirm to verify it and what you wrote is kept.
